title: Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

reports.title: Parkview High receives 4th AI-generated bomb threat this year
Hoax phone call at Gwinnett high school causes lockdown; campus cleared
Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

summary:
Parkview High School in Gwinnett County, Georgia received its fourth AI-generated bomb threat of the school year on Monday. School officials placed the campus on lockdown as a precaution, and normal operations later resumed. The latest threat followed a pattern seen in earlier incidents, involving a masked phone number. School police described the move as out of an abundance of caution in a letter to parents.

Gwinnett County school police are working with the Georgia Bureau of Investigation and the FBI to determine who is responsible for the threats. No arrests have been made and no suspect has been identified. The investigation is still ongoing, but authorities have not announced any additional steps or a timeline for resolving the case.
